scheme_name: Rajya Pratibha Khoj Pariksha Chhatravriti Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Rajasthan.
Applicant must be a student currently enrolled in Class 10 or Class 12.
Student must be studying in a government school, a recognized private school, or a Swami Vivekanand Model School located in Rajasthan.
For Class 10 applicants, a minimum of 50% marks must have been secured in Class 9.
For Class 12 applicants, a minimum of 50% marks must have been obtained in Class 11.
Applicant must have appeared for and qualified in the State Talent Search Examination conducted by the Board of Secondary Education, Rajasthan.
Applicant must have scored a minimum of 80% marks in the Talent Search Examination.
benefits_summary: Scholarship of up to ₹1,250 per month for Class 10 students and ₹2,000 per month for Class 12 students (UG/PG), plus a one‑time incentive of ₹4,000 for toppers and ₹2,000 for others, paid via Direct Benefit Transfer for up to 10 months.
